s.g: (US) In the southwestern US, a slope, specifically part of a piedmont slope made of rocky detritus.

bajan.f: Alternative form of bayan (“type of accordion”).

s.g: (geography) An island in Indonesia (part of the Riau Islands) with the coordinate location 3°7'31.84"N, 106°18'38.30"E.

(ethnology) The indigenous people native to Bajau island (part of modern-day Indonesia), these ethnic group nowadays predominantly inhabit the Bajau island and its adjacent regions in Indonesia and also expanded to the southern Philippines.
(slang, hyperbolic) An unspecified, absurdly large number (of).
(North India) Pearl millet (Cenchrus americanus, syn. Pennisetum glaucum).
A traditional Malay jacket worn with a sarong.
